$comment: Lelvo's design tokens, the one place colours and web type are defined. After editing, run python3 Scripts/design-tokens.py, which writes the app colour assets and the :root block of website/styles.css. Roles and rules: docs/DESIGN.md.

web-dark.$comment: Overrides for the website's dark theme (the toggle sets data-theme="dark"). Only colours change.

icon.$comment: The app icon and website icons are drawn by Scripts/brand-assets.py from design/logo/mark.svg and the brand colours below.

brand.$comment: Colours of the logo. violet to deep is the icon and launch gradient; launch is the solid launch screen behind the white mark; violet-light is the camel on the dark app icon, the same violet as the app's dark accent. Run python3 Scripts/brand-assets.py after changing them.
